# Three.js 0.180.0

Local copies of three.module.js, three.core.js and examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js.
Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180
License: MIT, included in LICENSE. No external viewer or tracking requests.

Herbi geometry is custom code, not a Pacdora, Sketchfab or Poly Pizza asset.
Textures are extracted from page 7 of the owner's original Herbi presentation.
Front, botanical side and black information side use an AI-assisted restoration
in assets/herbi-case/box-dieline-restored.png, referenced against the owner's
physical-box photographs. The original atlas is retained for the other faces.
Restoration is a visual portfolio asset, not a verified print-production master.
Dimensions and lid animation are illustrative, not manufacturing CAD measurements.
